# LSR-2 bill of materials and cost (generated by scripts/bom.py)

Authors: Anatol EA5KAO, Diego EA5JEF, Pedro Roca Molina (BricoHams). LSR-2 is a replica of the SARCNET SARCTrac Mk4 (FreeCAD files under the MIT licence, `third_party/sarctrac-mk4`). The default design is the Mk4 replica; the earlier cast/CNC design is the optional variant below.

## SARCTrac Mk4 replica (LSR2_DESIGN=mk4, default)

Source: `calc/lsr2_mk4_bom.py`, the single source of the Mk4 cost, mass and stock quantities. Lines `Rotator Assembly`, `Saddle` and `Thrust Bearing` are the three parts lists of the SARCNET Mk4 FreeCAD files (MIT licence, `third_party/sarctrac-mk4/`); the item number is in the last column. Lines marked `x` are model parts that are not rows of those lists (laser-cut cover and enclosure, corner blocks, mast bracket, platform, lift arms, EL hubs, dust caps, gaskets) and the electronics block is the Mk4 electronics. Every price is an estimate (**est.**, EU hobby suppliers, 2026); laser and CNC job prices are quotes to request before ordering. Made-part masses are the finished solids of `build/lsr2_build_report.json` (basis `report`, one value per part). Bought masses are catalogue values (`cat.`) or estimates (`est.`). The report models the pipe clamps and end stops as simplified solids; their catalogue masses are used.

### Totals (est.)

| **Cost, one rotator (incl. PSU and motor/sensor cable; without mast, antennas and coax run)** | **901 EUR (est.)** |

| of which made parts (report) | 7980 g |

Mass scope: included are the rotator head (mounting plate, covers, corner blocks, enclosure, platform), the electronics housing with the drivers, the two gearbox + motor assemblies, the lift arms, the saddle and the thrust bearing stack, and all fasteners. Excluded: mast, antennas, cables (and the motor/sensor cable in this list) and the indoor 48 V PSU. The cost total does include the PSU and the motor/sensor cable.

### Stock to buy (incl. nesting and blank margin)

Computed from the part bounding boxes of the build report: sheet = sum of the part rectangles + 30 % nesting; plate blank = bounding box + 5 mm per side x 10 mm; 16 mm bar = 16 mm x part width x (length + 10 mm cut); SHS and angle length + 10 mm cut per piece; stainless round = largest step + 3 mm. The same numbers are in [LSR2_MATERIALS](LSR2_MATERIALS.md).

The two worm gearbox assemblies (NMRV30-G50-D11, 23HS32-4004S, adaptor) dominate the cost and the mass. The lift-arm solid of the report includes the steel counterweight leaf of the SARCNET part file. See [LSR2_MK4](LSR2_MK4.md) for the build and [OPEN_ITEMS](OPEN_ITEMS.md).

## Optional cast/CNC variant (LSR2_DESIGN=cast)

Not generated: `build/lsr2_build_report.json` is missing or belongs to the Mk4 design. Build the cast variant (`LSR2_DESIGN=cast`, see [LSR2_ASSEMBLY](LSR2_ASSEMBLY.md)) and run `python scripts/bom.py` again.
